NavGeneralDesc: Game data, language and window behaviour
NavHotkeysDesc: All keyboard shortcuts in one place
GameModeSelectionSub: Which game mode prices and availability are based on
GameModeSelectionHint: Changing the game mode refreshes the item database.
MinimizeToTrayHint: Closing the window hides it to the system tray instead of exiting.
InterfaceLanguageHint: The language used for the RatScanner interface.
LogDebugInfoHint: Writes verbose scanning information to the log file.
NameScanGroupDesc: Reads the item name under the cursor using text recognition
IconScanGroupDesc: Matches the inventory icon under the cursor against known icons
NameScanHotkeyHint: Held while pointing at an item to scan its name.
EnableNameScanHint: Recognise item names from the screen.
AutomaticScanningHint: Also scan the whole screen when a name scan is triggered.
NameScanLanguageHint: The language the in-game item names are written in.
EnableIconScanHint: Recognise items from their inventory icon.
IconScanHotkeyHint: Held while pointing at an item to scan its icon.
ScanRotatedIconsHint: Also match icons that are rotated in the inventory.
UseCachedIconsHint: Reuse previously scanned icons to speed up repeated scans.
OverlayGroupDesc: A resizable search window that stays on top of the game
EnableSearchOverlayHint: Allow opening the interactive item search overlay.
BlurBehindSearchHint: Blur the game behind the overlay so text stays readable.
OverlayHotkeysGroupDesc: Keyboard shortcuts for the search overlay
AppHotkeysGroupDesc: Shortcuts that act on the last scanned item
HotkeysFooter: Click a shortcut to record it. Press Escape while recording to cancel.

OpenTarkovDevHint: Opens the tarkov.dev page for the last scanned item.
TooltipGroupDesc: How long item tooltips stay on screen
TooltipDurationHint: How long a scanned item tooltip remains visible.
MinimalUiGroupDesc: Which fields the compact item window shows
MinimalUiGroupFooter: The preview on the right updates as you change these options.
OpacityGroupDesc: Transparency of the minimal UI window
PreviewGroupDesc: A live preview of the minimal UI
PreviewEmptyLabel: All fields are hidden, the window will be empty.
ConnectionOkDetail: Your token is valid, progress data is being fetched.
ConnectionNoneDetail: Add an API token to track your quest progress.
ConnectionInvalidDetail: Check the token and try again.
TrackingGroupDesc: Highlight items you still need for tasks and the hideout
TarkovTrackerGroupDesc: Connect an account to track your progress
ShowNonFirNeedsHint: Mark items that are not found in raid as still needed.
ShowKappaNeedsHint: Additionally flag items needed to complete a task.
ApiTokenHint: Your personal API token from the selected service.
ShowTeammatesHint: Also show what your teammates still need.
ScreenConfigGroupDesc: The resolution RatScanner assumes the game is running at
ScreenConfigGroupFooter: Normally detected automatically. Only override this if scanning is inaccurate.
OverrideScreenConfigHint: Enter the resolution manually instead of using the detected one.
ScreenResolutionHint: Override the resolution and scaling used for scanning.
DiagnosticsGroupDesc: Files useful when reporting a problem
LogFileHint: Written to when debug logging is enabled.
DataFolderHint: Item icons, maps and recognition data.
PathNotFound: The path could not be found.
AboutCommunitySub: Report issues, ask questions and follow development
AboutSourcesSub: RatScanner is made possible by these projects
AboutSourcesFooter: Item data and images belong to their respective owners. Not affiliated with Battlestate Games.
AboutTarkovDevSub: Item prices, availability and trader offers
QuestFirHint: Must be found in raid or crafted
QuestAnyOfHint: Any one of the listed items satisfies this objective
QuestWikiHint: Open the task on the wiki
QuestUnmodeledHint: This task has requirements that are not fully detailed, such as time gates or other conditions
QuestObjectivesChipHint: Objectives you have already completed out of all of this task's objectives.
QuestPrereqChipHint: Prerequisite tasks you have completed out of all tasks that must be finished first.
QuestKappaHint: This task is required to unlock the Kappa container.
QuestLevelHint: The player level needed for this trader to offer the task.
QuestExperienceHint: Experience awarded for completing this task.
QuestFactionHint: This task only counts for the listed faction.
QuestLightkeeperHint: This task is required to unlock the Lightkeeper.
QuestRestartableHint: This task can be handed in more than once.
QuestNeededKeysHint: Keys that must be held for the maps this task takes place on.
QuestAnyOfChipHint: At least one objective accepts several different items, so any one of them counts.
QuestTraderLevelHint: The trader loyalty level needed for this trader to offer the task.
MapViewerHint: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan
MapNoDataHint: This map has no interactive map data, so it cannot be displayed.
ProgressSourceDesc: Where completed quests and objectives are saved
ProgressSourceHint: RatScanner saves your progress in a file on this computer. TarkovTracker saves it on your TarkovTracker account.
TarkovTrackerInactive: Set Progress Storage to TarkovTracker to connect an account and save your progress there.
LogTrackingDesc: Read the game log files to track quests, raids and your position. Nothing is sent anywhere.
LogTrackingEnableHint: Off by default. When on, RatScanner follows the game log files in the background.
LogTrackingQuestsHint: Marks a task done when the log reports it finished, and completes its objectives.
LogTrackingRaidHint: Shows a notification when a raid is found, starts and ends.
LogTrackingMode: Detect game mode from the log
LogTrackingModeHint: Notices when you switch between PvE, PvP and Seasonal. Nothing changes until you confirm it.
LogTrackingPosition: Show last known position on map
LogTrackingPositionHint: Uses your in-game screenshots to place an arrow on the map you are on.
LogTrackingPathHint: Leave empty to detect it automatically.
LogTrackingPositionMapHint: Used when no raid was tracked, so the position marker still has a map.
LogTrackingHistoryHint: Read a previous session's logs to pick up quests finished in raids that already happened.
